mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN Type = 1 AND SubType = 0 THEN '文本' WHEN Type = 3 AND SubType = 0 THEN '图片' WHEN Type = 34 AND SubType = 0 THEN '语音' WHEN Type = 43 AND SubType = 0 THEN '视频' WHEN Type = 47 AND SubType = 0 THEN '动画表情' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 1 THEN '特殊文本消息' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 5 THEN '卡片式链接' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 6 THEN '文件' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 8 THEN 'GIF表情' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 19 THEN '合并转发聊天记录' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType IN (33, 36) THEN '小程序分享' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 57 THEN '引用消息' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 63 THEN '视频号直播' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 87 THEN '群公告' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 88 THEN '视频号直播' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 2000 THEN '转账消息' WHEN Type = 49 AND SubType = 2003 THEN '红包封面' WHEN Type = 10000 AND SubType = 0 THEN '系统通知' WHEN Type = 10000 AND SubType = 4 THEN '拍一拍' WHEN Type = 10000 AND SubType = 8000 THEN '群聊邀请通知' ELSE '其他类型' END AS type, COUNT(*) as value FROM MSG GROUP BY Type, SubType;

SELECT strftime( '%m-%d', CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) AS type, '发送数量' AS category, SUM( CASE WHEN IsSender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS value FROM MSG WHERE DATE( CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) >= DATE( 'now', '-15 days', 'localtime' ) GROUP BY strftime( '%Y-%m-%d', CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) UNION ALL SELECT strftime( '%m-%d', CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) AS type, '接收数量' AS category, SUM( CASE WHEN IsSender = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS value FROM MSG WHERE DATE( CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) >= DATE( 'now', '-15 days', 'localtime' ) GROUP BY strftime( '%Y-%m-%d', CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) ORDER BY type, category

SELECT StrTalker as userName, COUNT( * ) AS total FROM MSG WHERE StrTalker NOT LIKE '%@chatroom' and StrTalker not in ('newsapp','notifymessage','filehelper','fmessage') AND DATE( CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) >= DATE( 'now', '-1 month', 'localtime' ) GROUP BY userName ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN IsSender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS SentMessages FROM MSG WHERE DATE( CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) = DATE( 'now', 'localtime' );
SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN IsSender = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS ReceivedMessages FROM MSG WHERE DATE( CreateTime, 'unixepoch', 'localtime' ) = DATE( 'now', 'localtime' );
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name LIKE 'Msg\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY name
SELECT user_name FROM Name2Id WHERE user_name IS NOT NULL AND user_name != ''

SELECT m.local_id AS localId, m.real_sender_id AS talkerId, CAST(m.server_id AS TEXT) AS msgSvrId, CAST(m.local_type & 4294967295 AS INTEGER) AS type, CAST(m.local_type >> 32 AS INTEGER) AS subType, CASE WHEN n.user_name = #{currentUser} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isSender, CAST(m.create_time AS INTEGER) AS createTime, m.sort_seq AS sequence, m.status AS status, m.server_seq AS msgServerSeq, CAST(m.sort_seq AS INTEGER) AS msgSequence, #{talker} AS strTalker, CAST(m.message_content AS TEXT) AS strContent, NULL AS displayContent, 0 AS reserved0, 0 AS reserved1, 0 AS reserved2, 0 AS reserved3, NULL AS reserved4, NULL AS reserved5, NULL AS reserved6, m.compress_content AS compressContent, m.packed_info_data AS bytesExtra, m.source AS bytesTrans, m.message_content AS rawContent, n.user_name AS senderUserName FROM [${tableName}] m LEFT JOIN Name2Id n ON n.rowid = m.real_sender_id ORDER BY m.sort_seq, m.local_id

SELECT CASE WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 1 THEN '文本' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 3 THEN '图片' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 34 THEN '语音' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 43 THEN '视频' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 47 THEN '动画表情' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 49 THEN '应用消息' WHEN (m.local_type & 4294967295) = 10000 THEN '系统通知' ELSE '其他类型' END AS type, COUNT(*) AS value FROM [${tableName}] m GROUP BY type

SELECT strftime('%m-%d', m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS type, '发送数量' AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN n.user_name = #{currentUser} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM [${tableName}] m LEFT JOIN Name2Id n ON n.rowid = m.real_sender_id WHERE DATE(m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') >= DATE('now', '-15 days', 'localtime') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%m-%d', m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS type, '接收数量' AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN n.user_name = #{currentUser} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS value FROM [${tableName}] m LEFT JOIN Name2Id n ON n.rowid = m.real_sender_id WHERE DATE(m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') >= DATE('now', '-15 days', 'localtime') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')
SELECT #{talker} AS userName, COUNT(*) AS total FROM [${tableName}] m WHERE DATE(m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') >= DATE('now', '-1 month', 'localtime')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.user_name = #{currentUser} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM [${tableName}] m LEFT JOIN Name2Id n ON n.rowid = m.real_sender_id WHERE DATE(m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = DATE('now', 'localtime')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n.user_name = #{currentUser} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) FROM [${tableName}] m LEFT JOIN Name2Id n ON n.rowid = m.real_sender_id WHERE DATE(m.create_time, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') = DATE('now', 'localtime')
